scenarios.description: Assistant requests a tool call, caller executes it and sends ToolResult back, assistant produces final answer.
Single assistant turn returns two distinct ToolCall blocks that are both preserved and echoed in subsequent ToolResult turns.
Thinking effort maps cleanly per protocol and opaque thinking signature survives response -> next request roundtrip.
cache_read_tokens / cache_write_tokens / reasoning_tokens / input_tokens / output_tokens / total_tokens are extracted accurately.
ImageBase64 and ImageUrl blocks translate across protocols; Audio on unsupported protocols throws explicit UnsupportedFeature.
Chunked SSE/NDJSON frames split mid-UTF8 or mid-line assemble cleanly and respect cancellation/timeout.
providerExtensions and custom baseUrl/headers pass through untouched to relay endpoints.
200 sequential calls against a single keep-alive mock server reuse connections without leaking descriptors or memory.
Unmappable features (e.g. rerank on non-Cohere, json_schema on Ollama when unsupported) fail explicitly instead of silently downgrading.
